item.title: Israelis denounce Trump’s deal with Iran
item.description: Israeli officials disparaged the peace deal and said Israel’s fight against Hezbollah in Lebanon would go on.

item.title: After news of Iran peace deal, Lebanese return home to assess wreckage
item.description: Some war-weary residents displaced from the south found relative quiet, with guarded optimism that Trump will pressure Israel to adhere to a truce.

item.title: In Mideast and worldwide, cautious relief over deal to end damaging war
item.description: Some world leaders hailed the deal, but many in the Middle East were cautious, saying important details remain to be settled and warning the accord could easily fall apart.

item.title: Foreign media were granted rare visas to cover Khamenei’s funeral. Here’s what our reporter saw.
item.description: A regime that has survived months of attack by the United States and Israel is projecting a show of strength with enormous crowds and the reappearance of military leaders.

item.title: U.S. gave Tehran details on Iranian asylum seekers, lawsuit alleges
item.description: The claim, outlined in court papers, contends information shared with Iran could jeopardize the lives of pro-democracy protesters, religious minorities and LGTBQ people.

item.title: Deadly Russian strikes hit Ukraine’s capital ahead of key NATO meeting
item.description: The overnight attacks on Kyiv killed at least 19 people as Russia stepped up a new offensive. Ukraine's president said NATO must do more to help his country intercept incoming missiles.

item.title: Belarus gets squeezed as Putin seeks war help and Ukraine threatens strikes
item.description: Ukraine’s northern neighbor was used as a staging ground for Russia’s 2022 invasion, but the country seems intent on not being drawn further into the Kremlin’s war.
